# ThirdWaveAI

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A paradigm of AI development characterized by contextual adaptation and reasoning, moving beyond the pattern recognition of second-wave deep learning. Provides the strategic motivation for TCC/iNEST architectures that must support dynamic, context-aware inference at the network edge.
